PREFIX brick: <http://brickchema.org/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <https://brickschema.org/schema/2.0/entity/ontology/point/point#>
SELECT ?p ?ts ?id WHERE {
  ?ahu brick:hasTag "AHU01" .
  ?p brick:hasPropertyOf ?ahu ; ref:hasTimeseriesId ?id .
  FILTER regex(str(?p), "Power", "i")
}

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.5#/v1/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { ?p a brick:ElectricPower . } LIMIT 20

PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.5#/v1/>
SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a brick:AirHandlingUnit . } LIMIT 20

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999-02-22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?cls (COUNT(*) as ?n) WHERE { ?s a ?cls . } ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 40

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?cls (COUNT(*) as ?n) WHERE { ?s a ?cls . } ORDER BY DESC(?n) LIMIT 40

PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999-02-22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?s ?o WHERE { ?s brick:hasTag | <> "AHU01" } LIMIT 5
